title: Splitting a bill to the cent without floating point
task: Implement `split.Even(totalCents int, people int) ([]int, error)`: shares differ by at most one cent, the first shares carry the extra cents, the shares sum to exactly the total, and zero people or a negative total is an error. Then `split.ByWeight(totalCents int, weights []int) ([]int, error)` allocating proportionally with the leftover cents going to the largest remainders first. No floating point for money.
